tracks.name: Fast-VLA · RoboTwin 2.0 Clean / Randomized
tracks.protocol: 作者报告的50任务平均；Clean与Randomized分开列出。官方仓库说明RoboTwin官方评测适配器每任务100 episodes。作者报告，非本站复现。
tracks.trainingRegime: 27,500 demonstrations（每任务50 clean + 500 randomized）；272M在线actor，冻结4B DM0.5 VLM在episode开始时构建task memory。

results.locator: Abstract; official repository README performance table
results.trainingData: Fast-VLA LIBERO checkpoint; 185M actor with frozen 4B DM0.5 VLM.
results.evaluationNotes: Overall average over 10,030 LIBERO-Plus variants, as reported by the authors. Kept separate from standard LIBERO; no cross-benchmark combined average is computed.

results.locator: Abstract; official repository README performance table
results.trainingData: 2,000 LIBERO demonstrations; 185M actor with frozen 4B DM0.5 VLM.
results.evaluationNotes: Overall average across the four standard LIBERO suites as reported by the authors. The source summary does not supply suite-wise values; none are inferred. Reported amortized inference is 3.975 ms/step and online resident memory 0.86 GiB, separate from SR.

results.locator: Abstract; official repository README performance table
results.trainingData: 27,500 demonstrations across 50 RoboTwin tasks: 50 clean + 500 randomized demonstrations per task; 272M actor with frozen 4B DM0.5 VLM.
results.evaluationNotes: Clean and Randomized success rates are kept separate. README also reports amortized inference 1.437 ms/step and 1.22 GiB online resident memory; these are separate metrics and are not encoded as success-rate values. Not independently reproduced by VLA-Radar.
